properties.descripcion: A group of three men followed the victim for 400 m along Nevsky Prospekt, between the Gostiny Dvor and Nevsky Prospekt stops, making comments and filming with a phone.

properties.titulo: Intimidation in the Moskovsky station concourse
properties.descripcion: Two individuals blocked a woman's path next to the suburban ticket counters and demanded her phone number. Security staff intervened after several minutes.
Sexual comments directed at a student in the university park next to the Vasileostrovskaya (line 1) station. No physical assault; the incident was logged to document the pattern.
